The stop hook is reporting the same four typecheck errors again. They were already in the repo, and none of them are in files I touched.

My change is done. I made no further edits this turn.

- **What I changed:** `core/util.ts`, `core/json-schema-processors.ts`, `core/to-json-schema.ts` and `classic/from-json-schema.ts`, plus the new `core/tests/json-schema-proto.test.ts`.
- **Test status:** the new test passes, and the type check on those files reports no errors.
- **What the hook is flagging:**
  - `packages/bench/key-iteration.ts` and `packages/bench/safeparse.ts` have unused variables (TS6133).
  - `packages/integration/fixtures/internal-types/cjs-test.cts` and `index.ts` have a CommonJS import of an ES module (TS1479) and another unused variable (TS6133).

The hook will keep failing until those files are fixed. They're outside this task, so I'd rather not edit them unprompted. If you want them fixed, say so and I'll do it as a separate change.
